sample_funnel.reason_detail: Keep a household iff its adults (aged 20 or over) are either exactly one unpartnered adult, or exactly two adults who name each other as partner and are of opposite sex. Drop households with no adult, with three or more adults, with two adults not mutually linked, and with a same-sex couple.
Every decider has 20 <= dag <= 60. For a couple this binds on BOTH adults.
Every decider has dec == 0 (not in full-time education).

sample_funnel.screen: no old-age, disability or survivor pension receipt
sample_funnel.reason_detail: Household total of pdi + poa + psu is exactly zero.
Every decider has les in {3, 5, 7}: employed, unemployed or inactive.

sample_funnel.screen: no other employable or earning member
sample_funnel.reason_detail: No NON-decider in the household is work-capable (aged 20 to 60, not disabled, not in education) or earns more than 50 EUR a month.

sample_funnel.screen: hours and wage inside the modelled support
sample_funnel.reason_detail: CORRECTED (floor 5). An employed decider observed above 70 h/week is capped at 70; one observed at or below 5 h/week becomes non-employed; hours strictly between 5 and 70 are KEPT AT THE OBSERVED VALUE. An employed decider's hourly wage must lie in [2, 170] EUR or the household is dropped.

sample_funnel.screen: hours outside [5,70] or unsupported military occupation (ISCO 0) on an employed decider
sample_funnel.operational_criterion: Evaluated on employed deciders using untouched source fields. Singles: 5 units on hours and a further 7 on ISCO 0. Couples: 24 on hours and a further 28 on ISCO 0; two of those households have both spouses in ISCO 0.
sample_funnel.economic_motivation: The closed interval [5,70] is the support the hours opportunity density is defined on, so an observed value outside it has no model alternative. ISCO 0 is the armed forces: the four-group civilian occupation aggregation does not define an alternative for it. This is unsupported occupation, NOT missing occupation.
